decision.interpretation: Document type title line. Bold, size 14, centered layout block b7, positioned prominently at top of page preceding the specific decree title.
Subtitle specifying the decree's scope. Bold, size 14, layout block b8, directly follows the document type heading and introduces the regulatory content.
Chapter heading. Bold, size 14, layout block b16, isolated line introducing the first substantive section of the decree.
Chapter title. Bold, size 14, layout block b17, follows the chapter number and names the general provisions region.
Article heading. Bold, size 14, layout block b18, introduces the first article's scope of regulation, followed by detailed regulatory text.
